label: ORL
description: Photobiomodulation en ORL : acouphènes, surdité et surdité brusque, rhinite allergique (photothérapie endonasale), rhinosinusite, troubles de l'odorat, suites d'amygdalectomie, vertiges.
hero: l'oreille, le nez et la gorge
exclusions_note: chirurgie laser ORL, photothérapie dynamique, lumière UV seule…
pubmed_query: ("photobiomodulation"[tiab] OR "low-level laser"[tiab] OR "low level laser"[tiab] OR "low-intensity laser"[tiab] OR "low-power laser"[tiab] OR "LLLT"[tiab] OR "PBMT"[tiab] OR "Low-Level Light Therapy"[MeSH] OR "light-emitting diode"[tiab] OR "laser acupuncture"[tiab] OR "repeated low-level red-light"[tiab] OR "low-level red light"[tiab] OR "red light therapy"[tiab] OR "high-intensity laser"[tiab] OR "laser biostimulation"[tiab]) AND ("tinnitus"[tiab] OR "hearing loss"[tiab] OR "hearing"[tiab] OR "rhinitis"[tiab] OR "sinusitis"[tiab] OR "rhinosinusitis"[tiab] OR "olfactory"[tiab] OR "smell"[tiab] OR "otitis"[tiab] OR "vertigo"[tiab] OR "tonsillectomy"[tiab] OR "pharyngitis"[tiab] OR "voice"[tiab] OR "Otorhinolaryngologic Diseases"[MeSH]) NOT ("photodynamic"[ti])
